fact: The interior ministry's ID4Africa presentation of 19-20 June 2019 shows an architecture of 1,541 commune databases where acts are keyed, checked and updated ("saisie, contrôle et MAJ"), feeding 48 wilaya databases and a national database over the ministry's network, and gives the national automated register as 102 million acts scanned and keyed: 68.65 million births, 17.70 million deaths and 15.64 million marriages.
title: Modernisation du Service Public en Algérie
publisher: Ministère de l'Intérieur, des Collectivités Locales et de l'Aménagement du Territoire
